scope: one pull request, merged only when a human names it on the command line

base_branch.unknown_base: refuse, exit 6; never guessed, not overridable with --force

exit_codes.3: CI pending, or the --wait deadline expired
exit_codes.5: stale base with file overlap, or overlap undeterminable
exit_codes.6: gates unevaluable: identity or compare API failure, or the PR's base branch is unknown

does_not_provide: branch protection or required status checks (a host feature, not this tool)
an allowlist of permitted base branches
any private workspace merge policy or review authority
